additional_info.subject: Defective and Damaged Spare Parts Received – Orders 9501584561 & 9501615184
additional_info.body:
Hello Team,
Hello Team,
I am writing to report issues with several spare parts received under the following purchase orders:
Purchase Order: 9501584561
Two items from this order arrived defective or damaged:
1. HMI Screen – RAFI MLFB 8EM5902-1AA00-6AA0
We replaced a Dlogic HMI screen in the field with a new RAFI unit from this order.
The screen did not output any image and remained completely black.
We verified all electrical contacts and performed voltage measurements, all of which were normal.
To exclude installation error, we arrived with an additional new RAFI screen and replaced it again.
The second screen worked properly without any issues.
This indicates that the original unit received from the order was defective.
2. ControlP. RAFI Middle Segment – MLFB 8EM5902-1AA02-0AA8
This item arrived with broken glass.
The units were tightly packed without adequate protection, and it appears that insufficient packaging caused one of them to break during transport.
Purchase Order: 9501615184 (Received Last Month)
Another issue was identified with item
8EM5902-1AA02-0AA8
:
The item was not shattered, but it arrived
detached from its metal plate
.
The metal plate itself is bent and had separated from the glass component.
We request an exchange of the items
.
Best regards,
Orel
Best regards,

Also agree on RMA process for this case. This one we’ll communicate with logistic center
Purchase Order: 9501615184 (Received Last Month)

this post
I can tell you that I have information that starting from 23/10/2025 supplier gave instructions to our logistical center to perform an inventory check (with specific instructions on how to identify if the part is OK or NOK).
If you received this last month, it could mean that the check is not effective and maybe there needs to be another way to do it. I’ll forward this situation with our responsible supplier quality manager that’s leading this case.
Any case, I agree on RMA process for all the cases above
Hope this is helpful,
